info.name: Leave Portal API
info.description:
Walks the whole leave workflow: balances, validation, overlap, approval, own-request protection, calendar and cancellation.
Start the backend first (http://localhost:8112), then run with the Collection Runner. The run is repeatable: it uses next year's dates and a freshly registered employee.

exec: // All test dates are in NEXT year, so they never collide with the seeded leave (which is all in the current year).
const add = (d, n) => { const t = new Date(d); t.setDate(t.getDate() + n); return t; };
while (base.getDay() !== 1) base = add(base, 1);          // first Monday of next year
base = add(base, 7 * Math.floor(Math.random() * 30));       // a random week, so repeated runs rarely share dates
set("w1mon", base); set("w1tue", add(base, 1)); set("w1wed", add(base, 2)); set("w1fri", add(base, 4));
set("w1sat", add(base, 5)); set("w1sun", add(base, 6)); set("w1nextmon", add(base, 7));
set("w4mon", add(base, 21)); set("w4nextfri", add(base, 32));  // 10 working days

item.name: Register a fresh employee for this run
Fresh employee has the full allowance
Days are reserved, not yet used

exec: pm.test("Start date field error", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().fieldErrors.startDate).to.include("no working days"));

item.name: Overlapping a pending request is a conflict
More than the balance is rejected

exec: pm.test("Only the unpaid one", () => { const l = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(l.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(l[0].leaveType).to.eql("UNPAID"); });

item.name: Overlapping approved leave is now blocked
Manager cannot approve their own request
Manager cannot reject their own request either
Another manager rejects it (no reason needed)
Approved leave shows on the calendar
A rejected request cannot be cancelled
Employee cannot see the team calendar
